title: Sadie Jane Starter Kit
body_html:
Launching Wednesday, November 25 at 10:00am CST.

Soft, romantic, and effortlessly charming, the Sadie Jane Starter Kit brings graceful florals and fresh pastel hues to your mahjong table. Thoughtfully curated with beautifully coordinated accessories, this collection blends timeless elegance with modern functionality to create a setup that feels light, inviting, and beautifully refined. Perfect for players who love feminine details, fresh color palettes, and a polished table that feels as lovely as it is fun to play.

What's Included

Sadie Jane Mahjong Tiles

Soft, feminine, and beautifully detailed, the Sadie Jane Mahjong Tiles feature a fresh palette of sky blue, blush pink, soft mint, and crisp white for a look that feels both elegant and playful. Delicate florals bloom across the flower tiles, while graceful bamboo, whimsical dot patterns, and refined character tiles create a balanced, easy-to-read design. Charming illustrations—including sweet birds, playful guardian lions, and beautifully styled Joker tiles—add personality throughout the set. Finished with layered edges in soft blue, blush, and mint, Sadie Jane delivers a fresh, romantic aesthetic that's timeless yet distinctly modern.

Tile Details

• 160 Acrylic Tiles
• Dice/Coin Bag
• 4 Instructional Cards

Tile Breakdown

• 1–9 Bams, Cracks, and Dots (4 of each) = 108
• North, East, West, South Winds (4 of each) = 16
• Red, Green, and White Dragons (4 of each) = 12
• Flowers (not numbered) = 8
• Jokers = 10
• Blanks = 6

Tile Size

• Individual Tile: 0.87" W × 0.6" D × 1.25" H

Serendipity Mahjong Mat

Bright, cheerful, and beautifully balanced, the Serendipity Mahjong Mat features an airy palette of soft sky blue, fresh chartreuse, blush pink, and delicate white florals. Graceful botanical details and layered geometric accents create a fresh, welcoming backdrop that perfectly complements the romantic styling of the Sadie Jane Tiles. The smooth neoprene surface allows tiles to glide effortlessly, while the cushioned backing enhances comfort and reduces noise.

• 33" × 33" neoprene mat
• Cushioned surface for smooth play
• Durable stitched edge
• Instructional layout printed directly on the mat

Storage
• Includes reusable storage tube
• Tube Dimensions: 33.5" long × 2¾" wide

Tile Storage Bag | Metallic Light Blue

Fresh and polished, this structured metallic light blue storage bag keeps your tiles secure and organized while adding a soft shimmer that beautifully complements the collection's fresh pastel palette.

Rack & Pusher Set | White

Clean and classic, these white racks and coordinating pushers offer a timeless look while providing smooth, functional gameplay.

Tile Shufflers | Light Pink

Designed for ease and efficiency, these shufflers make mixing tiles quick and seamless while adding a soft, feminine accent that pairs beautifully with the collection.

4 Line Finders | Light Pink

Simple and functional, these line finders help keep your place during gameplay while tying together the collection's soft blush accents.

4 International Mahjong Cards

A thoughtfully designed guide for modern Mahjong play, featuring clear, easy-to-follow formatting and support for gameplay with blanks.

• 18⅜" × 4¾" (open)

✨ Why You'll Love It

The Sadie Jane Starter Kit brings together soft florals, fresh pastels, and timeless design for a Mahjong collection that's equal parts elegant and inviting. With beautifully coordinated accessories and thoughtful details throughout, it creates a table that feels cheerful, polished, and effortlessly refined—perfect for hosting friends, gifting someone special, or enjoying every game in beautiful style.
